surface_mechanism_description: The self-limiting deposition in laser-ALE of GaAs is achieved by the laser-induced site-selective decomposition of alkylgallium on the As-terminated surface. The site-selectivity of alkylgallium decomposition in the laser-ALE of GaAs is based on the following two processes: (i) photon absorption by chemisorbed alkylgallium molecules due to the broadening of the optical absorption band, and (ii) transfer of carriers generated at the substrate by the laser irradiation to the chemisorbed molecules. For the laser-ALE of AlAs, the site-selective desorption of alkylaluminum is an important mechanism, as thermal desorption of alkylaluminum is taking place in the present growth temperature range.
